title: LIVE RELATIVE HUMIDITY
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km 2 m relative humidity analysis, hourly cycles
variable: RH 2 m above ground, analysis step
what: Near-surface (2 m) relative humidity from the operational HRRR analysis: the percentage saturation of air with water vapor at its current temperature. High values precede fog, dew, and cloud formation; low values accompany dry air, elevated evaporation, and fire-weather concerns around the Great Lakes basin.
field: Humidity science (atmospheric thermodynamics) studies water vapor as the fuel of weather: relative humidity governs evaporation, condensation, cloud nucleation, and atmospheric stability. It is distinct from absolute moisture measures such as precipitable water vapor and dew point, and is reported in percent.
